title: AI Gateway now supports Private Inference
summary_en: Private Inference connects your own model endpoints to AI Gateway . Enterprises running fine-tuned, self-hosted, or prerelease models used to need separate keys, client code, and logs for them. Those models can now run through the same authentication, SDKs and APIs , and observability as catalog models , so every model your team uses is managed in one place. Use Private Inference to: Switch between private and catalog models: Call private models through Chat Completions, Responses, or Messages.
